description: Autorités organisatrices compétentes en eau et assainissement is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto.karugeo.fr. The organization of current competences in water and sanitation follows the NOTRé Law of 2015 imposing a transfer of competences to inter-municipal structures before 2020. Since August 2016, five inter-municipal structures have been responsible for water and sanitation in Guadeloupe. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Organising authorities responsible for water and sanitation" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Assainissement, Eau potable, Autorité organisatrice. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
